_about: Our child (dungeon/life/our_child.py): the child's sheet by age band (temperaments for life, likes and quirks per band), their grandparents', aunts' and uncles' lines and their part in the family's holidays. Words only. Lines tagged 'older' are said only in older cities and 'modern' only in today's (as in families.json).
